message: おっぱいは正義である
Ria-senpai tossed the volleyball she was holding up into the sky.
Arrows of light chased after it.
A rhythm of ups and downs with varying pace. A force moving as if tracing a spiral left and right.
Keeping the falling speed in mind, she repeatedly juggled it, and with every impact, motes of light scattered.
Before long, the ball was launched far higher than eye level, and the sunlight got in the way of her vision.
From that point on, Ria-senpai kept her eyes closed the entire time.
Can she control the volleyball's behavior just by picturing the trajectory in her head?
For an instant, as she raised her spirit, the ball was launched straight up high.
The sharp arrows of light that had been striking the ball harshly transformed into a soft veil.
And then it wrapped around the ball as if comforting it.
Senpai stretched her arm toward the sky and raised her index finger.
The veil of light surrounded her slender arm, carving out a path for the ball yearning for the ground.
With Ria-senpai's body as the axis, the ball slid down a spiral slope.
Gently. Softly, it returned into Senpai's arms.

name: Synn
message: 「Ooooh~」
I found myself gazing at that sight in fascination.

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoops, messed up. Sorry, sorry!」
Even if we try doing the same thing as Senpai, it usually ends up like this.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
This time, I ended up tripping over a rolling ball.

name: Misa
message: 「You're not watching your step.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you guys didn't pick them up properly...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's quite difficult, isn't it~」

name: Ria
message: 「If you keep practicing, you'll be able to do it right away\s07」
Senpai had been doing this training since before she met us.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Alright! I'll do it too!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, Prez. Whatcha doin'~」

name: Synn
message: 「Special training.」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh, looks fun. Let me borrow that for a sec.」
Sally-chan abruptly snatched the ball, balanced it on the pad of her finger, and spun it all at once with a little impish breath.
The ball, spinning at a dizzying speed, bounced lightly atop her finger.

name: Sally
message: 「Hup.」
She had only flicked it lightly with her finger, yet it popped up high enough to easily clear the school building's roof.
Naturally, there was no way to follow it with our eyes.
By the time we noticed, it was plummeting at a ferocious speed and buried itself into the ground.
Even so, the ball continued to spin vigorously

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing... How are you doing that?」

name: Sally
message: 「It's magic.」
She meant it literally.

name: Sally
message: 「Come here.」
Called back by her voice, the ball returned like a yo-yo and snapped right into its master's palm.

name: Sally
message: 「Hah, hup, tah.」
With a flick of her wrist, it rolled across her arm, shoulder, and the nape of her neck.
Using her back like a spring, she launched the ball and caught it with the tip of her tail.

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Got myself a sexy shot of Ria-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy!! Coming out right now is bad news!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hup!」
Poked lightly by her tail, the ball floated softly into the air before immediately heading toward the ground.
Timing the exact moment the ball passed her waist, Sally spun her body around--

name: Sally
message: 「Burning Shoooot!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gaaah!!」
She energetically kicked away the flame-cloaked ball, and Paqy took a direct hit. He wouldn't have gotten blasted if he hadn't come out.
Sally had effortlessly pulled off the special training we were struggling with, as casually as some pro soccer player taking a breather.

name: Synn
message: 「That's incredible.」

name: Sally
message: 「Heheh. Something like this is a piece of cake.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Somehow, I'm starting to feel confident.」

name: Sally
message: 「Did I inspire you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. If even a tagalong like you can do it, it seems like I'll be able to pull it off right away too.」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, I see, I see--」

name: Sally
message: 「--Wait, are you making fun of me!? What's your deal, when you're totally hopeless at it yourself!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm just not used to it yet.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph. It wouldn't change anything even if I got used to it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What did you saaaay!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, that's enough fighting」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let me goooo」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, you too, Sally-chan」

name: Sally
message: 「Kyaa, don't touch me in weird places, you pervert!!」

name: Synn
message: 「There's nothing there to touch in the first place--」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow-ow-ow」

name: Sally
message: 「How rude! You're all weaker than me anyway!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What kind of half-asleep nonsense are you spouting?」

name: Sally
message: 「Acting all high and mighty. Are you saying there's someone stronger than me?」

Whoa, Lolotte's acting tough.

name: Lolotte
message: 「To tell you the truth, it's Senpai-san」
Passing the buck to someone else, huh.

name: Sally
message: 「All she has are huge boobs!! There's no way someone like that is stronger than me!」
She's just naturally crossing her arms, yet the breasts resting atop them are making their own bold statement.

name: Sally
message: 「D-Don't think you've won!!」

name: Ria
message: 「......Sally-chan. Won't you have a match with me?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hold on a second on the sexiness contest!! Wait another 1,000 years--no, 100 years!! Then I'll be super busty and bouncy too!」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not the kind of match I meant\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's not Misa, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「I wouldn't do that either!!」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, you won't even live that long」

name: Ria
message: 「No, Sally-chan. The match is going to be with this... okay?」
Ria-senpai holds up her weapon and shoots a challenging look.

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm~ So a mere human thinks she can beat me.」

name: Sally
message: 「I thought your boobs were the only cheeky thing about you, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Enough about my chest already, okay\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「You've got some nerve!! Fine, let's do this.」
A dignified stance Ria-senpai only shows in battle.
Even though Sally-chan is acting just like usual, the air alone is tense.
The two face each other. Ria-senpai is the only one holding a weapon at the ready.

name: Ria
message: 「Are you ready?」

name: Sally
message: 「Come at me from wherever you want~」
Beads of sweat rolling down Ria-senpai's forehead.
Sally-chan kept her eyes locked firmly on the exact moment she clenched her teeth.

name: Sally
message: 「You're all bark and no bite. So lame. If you're not gonna move, then I'll--」
All I did was swallow and blink. Yet the scene before my eyes shifts completely.
Consecutive blasts of power assaulted Ria-senpai. One, two, three of them.
Senpai precisely cancels them out and shoots them down.

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph, not bad at all.」
Without changing her expression, she sends out a second wave. Power faithful to Sally-chan's will bared its fangs at Ria-senpai's body.

name: Ria
message: 「Kuh!」
Trembling from the impact, Senpai's expression turned grim.

name: Sally
message: 「Come on, come on, I'm not done yet~~♪」
One technique after another, unleashed at will, forces Ria-senpai back from her footing.
Rather than canceling them out, it feels much more like she's parrying them away.
Is she aiming for something, or is she just being pushed around?

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's completely on the defensive. She can't even land a hit.」

name: Misa
message: 「No way...! Onee-sama is being pushed back!?」

name: Synn
message: 「No!」

name: Sally
message: 「Nngh...」
No matter how much magic she fires, Senpai's stronghold refuses to crumble.
Even though Sally-chan had been looking down on her opponent until now, she bit her lip as a look of impatience deepened on her face.

name: Sally
message: 「W-Why isn't it working~~!?」
The myriad spells show no sign of weakening, greedily and relentlessly trying to devour Ria-senpai.

name: Sally
message: 「Waaah!」
Every now and then, Ria-senpai emits bursts of light as if to intimidate her.
Her aim is sloppy, barely grazing past Sally's side, yet her opponent twists her body in exaggerated reactions.

name: Sally
message: 「So annoying!! I'm not gonna forgive you for fighting so cheap!!」
Growing irritated, Sally-chan speeds up her spellcasting.
The sheer number swells while maintaining the same power, though her aim becomes unfocused in return.
Ria-senpai's interceptions visibly decrease.

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr! Hit her, hit her!!」
Ria-senpai, who ought to have been pushed back, steps forward one pace at a time.

name: Sally
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hah!!」
Slipping inside her guard, Ria-senpai raises her weapon.

name: Sally
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「She dodged it!?」
With a somersault, Sally-chan escapes unscathed.

name: Sally
message: 「That was close!」

name: Sally
message: 「Too bad, buzzer beater. Better luck next time! You're wide open\s04」
Having just unleashed her magic, Ria-senpai freezes in place.

name: Misa
message: 「Sister!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Gotcha!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah」
Yet, Senpai's eyes hadn't given up!
Sally-chan's body floats into the air.
Higher than where she usually hovers.
She arches her body like a mermaid leaping above the water's surface.
The light she was supposed to have dodged moments ago envelops Sally-chan's back.
The light turns into sea spray clinging to a mermaid, melting away like bubbles in the air.
And that's where the slow motion ends.

name: Sally
message: 「Kyaaaaah」
Ria-senpai reaches out toward Sally-chan's blasted body and catches her firmly in her arms.
But their momentum didn't stop there, and the two of them tumbled head over heels, rolling forward again and again as they gave themselves over to the impact.
Digging their heels into the ground, they came to a sudden stop.
Leaving ruts behind them, the two finally came to a halt.

name: Sally
message: 「Kyuru~n\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... Maybe I overdid it just a li~ttle bit\s04」
Covered in grass, Ria-senpai stuck out her tongue.

name: Nanaka
message: 「A huge victory for Senpai~~!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, I believed in you from the very start, of course」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amazing, simply amazing! That was a stunt scene that would put professional action stars to shame!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So you doubled back anticipating she would dodge. Impressive as always, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though it was a close call」

name: Nanaka

name: Misa

name: Ria
message: 「Still, Sally-chan was super strong. If I'd let my guard down for even a second, she would've had me right away」
Even compared to other demons, Sally-chan was extraordinarily strong.

name: Synn
message: 「Being able to put up such a good fight against someone like her is certainly the fruit of our daily training」

name: Ria

name: Sally
